description: Get the cheapest cached flight tickets for a route (one per destination, cheapest first). Uses IATA city/airport codes. Example: travelpayouts_cheap_prices({ origin: "MOW", destination: "BCN", currency: "usd", _apiKey: "token:marker" })

depart_date.description: Departure date, format YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD (optional)

destination.description: Arrival IATA city/airport code, e.g. "BCN", "HKT". Optional — omit for cheapest from origin to anywhere.

return_date.description: Return date, format YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD (optional, for round trips)

name: travelpayouts_cheap_prices
